newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: At least 10 die in Colombia bus crash.
newsitem.headline: At least 10 die in Colombia bus crash.

text.p: A bus ran off the highway and plunged into a 150 foot (50 m) deep ravine in western Colombia on Monday, killing at least 10 and leaving five injured, Civil Defence officials said.
The cause of the accident, which took place on the road between La Celia and Pereira in Risaralda province, was not immediately known.
"The bus rolled off the highway into a ravine. There are at least 10 dead and five others injured," Civil Defence coordinator Jairo Diaz Granados said.

In January, 37 people, almost all members of the same family died, in a bus accident in southern Narino province, and 13 soccer fans died in a separate crash two weeks later in western Quindio province.
